pre_mortem: The solver fixes eight departures, writes a reference from WB-5 and fuzzes. Grepping 'gives no rule' finds only 2.6, a general sentence about figures a lot does not have; to use it the solver must ask, for every clause, which lots lack the figure it needs, and the two classes (lots billed a minimum fee; lots with no billed week) are outcomes of the storage and week logic it is rewriting, not flags in the data. Its natural surcharge fix rounds every lot half up; its natural peak rewrite takes max over billed weeks with a default of 0 (or crashes and then chooses 0). A solver that enumerates the terms of section 2 against the rules that use them keeps both.

score_notes.restraint_traps: two traps of different kinds on different nodes with computed membership; one general sentence covers both, so one careful policy still disarms both
score_notes.fuzz_blind_spot: a self-fuzz against the solver's own reference agrees wherever the reference holds its reading; T1 shows only as a one-cent difference on minimum-fee lots, T2 only on lots dispatched before their next anniversary

decisive_reason: the exclusions are now computed from repaired figures and located only through a general sentence, the shape that held on claude-opus-5 in icpms, but the kept values are each one small branch a definition-auditing solver will add
